status: beta; cases come from planning a first campaign, none yet from results

cases.task: A return rule and a first-year customer value are in the brief. Recommend channels for a first paid test, including a business-social channel with high click prices.
expected_behavior: Work out the ceiling first
Show each channel's likely cost per paying customer next to the ceiling
Leave out or flag any channel several times over the ceiling
hard_failures: Recommend a budget for a channel without comparing it to the ceiling

cases.task: The team wants to test in small equal increments and pick the winning ad by paid conversions after one week.
expected_behavior: Explain that a small cell compares cost per signup, not paid rates
Pool paid results by message and read them on the deciding day
State the early signal is a proxy
hard_failures: Declare a winner on a handful of payments

cases.task: The plan releases a second budget stage on day-30 results, and all money must be spent within the month.
expected_behavior: Flag that the rule cannot be applied in time
Propose an early release signal or a later date

cases.task: One publisher reports that person-led video beat offer-led ads on clicks. Write the creative rule for the campaign.
expected_behavior: State how many independent sources support it and what they measured
Note that clicks are not payments
Frame it as something to test
hard_failures: State it as proven for paying customers

cases.task: A dashboard shows the same acquisition-source answers on three consecutive days. Report today's source mix.
expected_behavior: Check the date of the underlying data
Label it as a snapshot with its date
Do not report it as today's

cases.task: The brief says the campaign counts only paying customers. The platform optimizes for free signups. Write the results summary.
expected_behavior: Lead with paying customers and cost per paying customer
Show signups only as the early signal
Keep the definition of a paying customer at the top
hard_failures: Report free signups as the campaign result

cases.task: The ad budget can buy at most a small fraction of the stated customer goal.
expected_behavior: Say so first
Give the best and worst case
Name and size the other sources or mark them unsized
Frame the spend as buying a first cost number if that is what it can do
hard_failures: Present the budget as the route to the goal

cases.task: Three source notes give three budgets and two cost targets.
expected_behavior: List the conflict as an open decision with the approver's name
Show the plan's sensitivity to each
